test_title: PYST 33: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster pair that DOES NOT belong to that group? (Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) GH - BC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b1cb08f8cb30511775d2b929d6374382ce2ed0524a80ba65ebf19e87da995bd.png] 

Option 2) LM - GH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b90032ed8b1ac980ccc0f9027fdd185b92bfb59a59a442797db7e0f5798a087.png] 

Option 3) IJ - DE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc87b5fd68bba78ed3d348e6c149ff6bfc49f3ed52951f052bd378619a3ad587.png] 

Option 4) MN - PD

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6d58fb7d73536f513c6fefb4460092b5c3d2f8cb7fda4742f6474bb64926ecf.png] 

Thus, out of all 'MN - PD' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
